desc: Alloy receiver, matte gray finish, tapered bull barrel, overmolded ambidextrous grips, blowback action, single-action trigger, adjustable and fiber-optic sights. What does "practical" mean? "Practical" essentially boils down to something that just works extremely well. It doesn't mean devoid of features, it just means we've placed emphasis on the features that really matter when it comes to function and ergonomics. The Buck Mark Practical URX is designed with ambidextrous Utragrip RX grips for positive control of the pistol and trigger. The adjustable Pro-Target rear sight can be dialed in super tight, and the TRUGLO/Marble Arms fiber optic front sight will allow you to quickly acquire targets even in low light conditions. The tapered bull barrel isn't flashy, but it gives you just enough weight to keep the gun steady for quick follow up shots.
